mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.booking_id AS bookingId, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.court_name AS courtName, b.sport_name AS sportName, b.contact_name AS contactName, v.method, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(v.verified_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS verifiedAt FROM s_verification v JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = v.booking_id WHERE v.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY v.verified_at DESC
